required_stages.description: Allocate C (M, N) int32 inside run().
On the device, inside the GEMM pass: field i of each packed byte = ((byte >> 2i) & 3) - 1, paired with A columns i*K_b + r; no unpacked B in global memory.
int8 x int8 products accumulated exactly in int32 per logical output tile; int32 tile stored.

forbidden_substitutions.message: infix @ matrix multiply on the data path
host-side decode of the packed B with PyTorch bit operations
transposed copy of the packed B: permitted only per call inside run() as counted device work, never cached across calls
Possible cross-call cache keyed by input identity/data pointer; transformed operands must be rebuilt inside every run().
floating-point evaluation of an integer product

required_evidence.message: a device-side 2-bit field decode (shift and mask)

outputs.aliasing: none: fresh (M, N) int32 tensor allocated inside run()

timing_boundary.notes: The GPU time of all device work launched by run() on every call is counted: the GEMM launch(es) and, if the design uses one, the per-call K-major copy of the packed B. The output allocation call and descriptor/metadata construction are host-side work and not GPU time. Decided rule: A and the packed B are delivered row-major and may be consumed as delivered or through a repack of the still-packed B rebuilt by device work inside every run(); cross-call caches of a transformed or decoded operand keyed on input identity, data pointer, shape or values are forbidden; no prepacked inputs may be assumed. Decode stays on the device inside the GEMM pass; a globally materialised unpacked (K, N) B is forbidden even per call. Packed-byte reuse across the four fields is an optimisation, not a requirement. Only the declared shape (K a multiple of 1024) is required. bytes_expr counts A, packed B and C once; repack traffic is diagnostic.
